prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-33790 from Quillon Analytics
prose.body:
Hi Fallowfield Games team,

Hope you're having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-33790 for the amount of 3803.51 USDC. We haven't received the payment yet, and we want to make sure everything is in order on your end.

If you've already sent this, please ignore this note. Otherwise, you can settle the balance by sending USDC to our standard vendor wallet: 0xf0c3a25511a57c4f91c6337bbb1e87b33ec33b15. This is the same address we've used for previous transactions, so it should be in your payment records.

Please let us know if you need an updated invoice or if there’s any confusion with the details. We appreciate your business and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable Team
Quillon Analytics
